title: Appending to a Pair Encoding
statement: For any binary strings $a,b,c$, concatenating $c$ to the encoding $\langle a,b\rangle$ gives the encoding $\langle a,bc\rangle$; that is, $\langle a,b\rangle c=\langle a,bc\rangle$.
replaced: Let $\langle a,b\rangle$ denote the self-delimiting pair encoding of bit strings $a$ and $b$ (every bit of $a$ doubled, then $01$, then $b$). For all bit strings $a, b, c$, appending $c$ to $\langle a,b\rangle$ appends it to the second component: $\langle a,b\rangle\, c = \langle a, b\,c\rangle$, where juxtaposition denotes concatenation.
